routes.boundary: 两侧都由 ast 静态派生：窗口层的 _plan/_refuse/STEP_ROWS 行与 runner 里 plan=… 的赋值是写方，plan['reason'] 比较是读方；只对计划这一层设闸，回合结论与设置项交给 pages.kind_of，运行期拼出的词记为未解析。 证据关系另由 plan_reasons.acting_plans/unproven 派生：只数得出"有证据/无证据"，判不出"证据是否永远成立"。 D56: the archive can only see pages and only from runs older than the change; a state proof can be demanded, never derived from it. D57: the archive can compare an observed page with the successor set a plan declared; it cannot see a frame, so an advance plan's pixel proof stays invisible to it. D58: the archive compares a landing with the pages a plan named; a landing at UNKNOWN is reported apart as a reading question, and a plan proved by a dismissal has nothing to forget. D64: 两个曾对静态读者不可见的词改为在 window 层写字面量，PLANS_THE_INDEX_CANNOT_NAME 清空但仍被门读取；运行时拼出的计划与"归档有、源码无"的词依旧是声明并计数的义务。

routes.boundary: 静态：只给出写方名字，不给原因；历史 91 条结束永远 unrecorded。 D59: an ending may follow a bounded retry of a failed read, so the reason can be the read's own (the_page_read_did_not_come_back_inside_its_window) rather than the loop's generic task failure. D60: a failed read is bounded twice -- consecutively inside one settle loop (unreadable_rounds, default 2) and by steps at the top (read_retries); the two are independent numbers and the step record carries reads_failed. D61: the six phase-6 figures come from run_metrics.efficiency/metrics/portfolio; a figure the journal cannot supply is None with a reason, never 0. D63: 领奖结果由 reward_task 自己写（executed/stopped/skipped），payout_rate 的分母是"记录了领奖结果的运行"；142 局旧日志没有这个事件，所以它是 None 且一直是，放宽语料 glob 必须作为单独一次决定。 D66: 秒数按"到下一行"的间隔记在前一行账上，它是预算不是 profile；占比的分母是已归属秒数，解释不了的部分单列。 D67: 步进比率的分母是各局声明的步数，心跳条数只作记录说明；分子只取声明过步数的那批局。 D68: 每次读取现在自述时长，于是"读取组"可以被拆成节点自己与包装；旧语料没有这个字段，必须读成未测量。 D70: 读取的 `seconds` 现在带三段（整帧 OCR / ROI 重读 / 分类）；缓存命中不报时间，旧语料报"分段未测量"，且回放帧不含设备截图。 D72: 动作节点失败即结束会话；此后任何输入都被拒绝。它不解释节点为什么失败。

routes.boundary: 这一层证明的是拒绝、取帧与记账；它不证明某个场景的期望合理，也没有把 29 个仍然经邻居 import Replay 的工具摊平——清单如实报出这条链。 D53 adds the runtime proof: the layer is built in a test, so a construction failure cannot hide behind a static count; the 46 neighbour imports are reported, not flattened. D54 flattened every tool whose source class only stored a frame (46 -> 12 neighbour imports), so what remains is exactly the tools whose expectation needs flattening one at a time. D55: the layer holds the mechanical half (frames, advance, records); a scene still owns its own expectation, and the five remaining scene reuses keep theirs.
